On main a5870a2, 16 of 58 `// Generated from prompts/... (sha256: X)` headers in src/ do not match sha256 of the named prompt (for example src/autopilot.mjs, src/runtime-preflight.mjs, src/prompt-approve.mjs, src/workflow-runs.mjs). No test, lint or CI step compares them (git grep 'Generated from' in test/, scripts/, .github/: none).

`node bin/pdd.mjs test --files STORY --app-map X` passes the option check on 0.1.20 (it then validates X). Adding `--timeout 15` gives the same 'mix of options' error, and the pddq staging wrapper adds `--timeout 15` (stated in #2671). The allow rule (src/runtime-client.mjs:2325) was already in alpha-v0.1.10. Small leftover: the error does not name the conflicting option.

Reporter's own follow-up: it happened in a staging maintenance window, and a newer client then got a real 'running' lint receipt. 0.1.20 waits for lint capacity, reads lost replies by id and saves a readable batch (docs/lint-capacity.md; src/runtime-client.mjs:1497). Related open #3028 (lint cannot get a slot). Reopen only if a 0.1.20 lint id gets 404.

closeChats runs only on cancel (src/workflow-runner.mjs:2479). startNextChat opens a new tab per area and never closes the prior one (src/workflow-runner.mjs:1860-1879, src/workflow-chat.mjs:312). No free-pane check before start.
